notes: Fixes hotkeys sending Diablo II to the back of the screen. If you triggered an action with a modifier hotkey - Alt+E for New Game, Alt+Q, Alt+R - the Alt you were still holding combined with the key the app sent, and a held Alt plus Escape is Alt+Escape, which Windows reads as 'send the active window to the back'. The game dropped behind everything and the action did not land. It only showed up in windowed mode; fullscreen hid it. The app now releases any modifier you are physically holding for the instant it sends a key, then hands it straight back, so your hotkey still works and the game only sees the key meant for it. Everything from 5.0.1.8 is included; only this changed.
